title: MoiUserProfile
description: Internal structured user profile for Moi, updated incrementally every month.

version.description: Increments with each monthly profile consolidation cycle.

core_traits.description: Key personality tendencies (e.g. 'High introversion', 'Deep introspective thinker', 'Sensitive to environmental shifts')

core_values.description: Demonstrated non-negotiable personal values inferred from answers.

primary_triggers.description: Things that evoke stress, joy, or deep reflection.

behavioral_observations.description: Observed real-world habits or choice patterns.

growth_milestones.description: Recent shifts in perspective or self-awareness achieved.
